findings.value: A bakery and café in a railway arch in Hackney, started in 2010 and known for its sourdough bread, with baking classes. Time Out describes it as a hub of the east London sourdough scene.

evidence.quote: commissioning and building a clay oven in the corner of a railway arch
e5 Bakehouse began in the spring of 2010, after Ben had taken a short course
Find out more about our in person baking school.
It was and is the epicentre of the east London sourdough revolution.

findings.value: Time Out describes it as busy from morning to evening, with casual tables for drinkers and diners.

evidence.quote: Indoors it’s quietly buzzy from dawn to dusk with informal tables of drinkers and diners

notes: Time Out's page gives the Hackney site as Arch 396, E8 3PH; the venue's site gives Arch 395 (facts aspect to check). The Time Out review is dated 21 Mar 2023 (last updated 27 Oct 2025 on the page).
